name: B10-0461/2026 (PfE) – Human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the human rights situation in Iran, notably the cases of Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making demands. It condemns Iran's repression of protesters, women, journalists and minorities. It names two women sentenced to death, Taraneh Rahimi and Leila Abolhasani, and calls for their release. It asks Iran to stop all executions and free political prisoners. It also asks European Union countries to sanction Iranian officials responsible and to act against Iranian pressure and plots inside Europe.

- What changes: nothing yet; it is a statement of demands, not a law.
- Who it affects: Iran's government and officials, and the prisoners named.
- What happens next: the text goes to European Union leaders and Iran's authorities.
